description: Countermeasure vs no countermeasure on the SIMULATED timeline. Same windows, flights and seeds in every pair.

countermeasure.layer1_data_health_gate: 3 reference flights per window logged by both A and B and uploaded manually; per-window audit of B against A on them (95% t-interval on the energy ratio): recalibrate B if the interval excludes 1, keep if it sits within 1 +/- 0.05, otherwise keep at weight 0.2. No records discarded. Freshness flag on the automatic A upload.
countermeasure.layer2_decision_safeguards: P90 calibrated on held-out trusted flights (reference flights and accurate-logger flights) from the last 3 windows. CONTINUE / RETURN / DEFER: defer when the P50-P90 band straddles the budget, or when health is red and the P90 clears the budget by less than 1.0 Wh. Deferred flights are scored as returned (the operator's safe choice) and counted as human workload. auto_* counts score the plain P90 rule on the fixed model.
countermeasure.cost: 3 dual-logged reference flights per window (about 12% of flights)
